fact: The June 2023 terms of reference, financed by a World Bank grant (Liberia Urban Resilience Project), state that Monrovia and Paynesville city corporations have inadequate systems to collect market, business registration and waste fees and plan a GIS-based platform storing tax and fee collection data and a digital payment system for them.
title: Final REOI for Revenue and PFM Advisor (Terms of Reference, Integrated Advisor for Own Source Revenue Generation and Municipal Financial Management)
publisher: Liberia Urban Resilience Project, Ministry of Public Works, Republic of Liberia
